biz.name: Lumi Hospital
biz.intro: A multi-speciality hospital where senior specialists, modern diagnostics and genuinely kind people work as one team, around the clock.
biz.address: Address line, Area, City, State PIN

departments.name: Cardiology
departments.summary: Heart checks, cardiac imaging, interventions and rehab.
departments.about: From a first ECG to complex angioplasty, our cardiac team covers prevention, diagnosis, intervention and long-term heart care, with an ICU and emergency team on call day and night.

departments.name: Neurology
departments.summary: Stroke, epilepsy, headache and nerve disorders.
departments.about: Rapid emergency assessment, an epilepsy clinic and neuro-diagnostics help us find the cause quickly and start treatment while it matters most.

departments.name: Orthopaedics
departments.summary: Joint replacement, sports injuries, spine and trauma.
departments.about: Joint replacement, arthroscopy and spine surgery, supported by in-house physiotherapy so recovery starts the day after surgery.

departments.name: Obstetrics & Gynaecology
departments.summary: Pregnancy, safe birth and lifelong women's health.
departments.about: A Neonatal ICU in the same building and a team that stays with you from the first scan to the first vaccination.

departments.name: Paediatrics & NICU
departments.summary: Newborn intensive care, child health and vaccinations.
departments.about: Child-friendly consultation rooms, a well-baby clinic and a fully equipped NICU for the smallest patients.

departments.name: Internal Medicine
departments.summary: Adult medicine, diabetes, BP and preventive care.
departments.about: Your first stop for undiagnosed symptoms, long-term conditions and coordinated care across specialities.

departments.name: Pulmonology
departments.summary: Asthma, COPD, sleep and lung function.
departments.about: Lung function testing and respiratory care, with ICU support when breathing gets serious.

departments.name: Nephrology & Urology
departments.summary: Kidney care, dialysis, stones and prostate.
departments.about: Kidney care and minimally invasive urology for kidney stones and prostate conditions.

departments.name: Gastroenterology
departments.about: Diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopy, liver clinics and day-care procedures, so you're usually home the same day.

departments.name: Diagnostics & Imaging
departments.summary: 24/7 lab, CT, MRI, X-ray and ultrasound.
departments.about: An in-house laboratory and imaging with digital reports, often on your phone within hours.

faq.q: Do I need an appointment for the OPD?
faq.a: Walk-ins are welcome, but booked patients are seen first. Booking takes under a minute online or on WhatsApp.
Yes. We work with major insurers and TPAs. Bring your policy card and photo ID; our insurance desk handles pre-authorisation.

faq.q: What should I bring for my first visit?
faq.a: A photo ID, previous prescriptions and reports, a list of current medicines and your insurance card if you have one.

faq.q: How do I get my lab reports?
faq.a: Reports are sent to your registered mobile number and can be collected from the lab counter.
General wards: 11 AM – 1 PM and 5 PM – 7 PM. ICU visits are limited to one attendant at set times; please ask the nursing station.
Yes, on-site parking is available for patients and visitors, with drop-off right at the emergency entrance.
